source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Extend a decimal sequence by identifying the repeated change from one term to the next.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Sequence is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Extend a decimal sequence by identifying the repeated change from one' is answered as sequence rather than term.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Sequence is what produces term, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Extend a decimal sequence by identifying the repeated.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is term because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Extend a decimal sequence by identifying the repeated change from one' as the operative test.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: term is settled by running 'Choose the decimal closest to a target value by comparing distances': The closest decimal to a target is the option with the smallest distance from the target — on the item about Extend a decimal sequence by identifying the repeated.

intelligence.enrichment: A decimal sequence can be extended by finding the constant amount added or subtracted between consecutive terms, then applying that same change to each new term.
